name: See You Next Time!
description:
Still want more? Consider doing another run! Maybe even with some restrictions if you want to spice it up a bit. Check the first quest chapter for some recommendations!

There's also roles to be earned for completing the pack two or even three times if you want an extra incentive.

[note]This quest and “The Factory Must Grow!” are mutually exclusive; completing one will lock the other.

If you are going for 100% questbook completion, don't panic, finishing either quest still allows the tab to receive a green check (much like the previous XOR quests).[/note]
